description.en: Splits a question into sub-questions, searches in parallel (Tavily), reads the best sources, checks each claim against independent sources, and writes a cited report in which every statement carries a numbered source.
description.ru: Раскладывает вопрос на подвопросы, ищет параллельно (Tavily), читает лучшие источники, проверяет каждое утверждение по независимым источникам и пишет отчёт, где у каждого утверждения есть номер источника.

ru: Найди в интернете, чем отличаются тарифы Stripe и Paddle, с источниками
Сделай обзор рынка CRM для малого бизнеса со ссылками
Погугли актуальные требования к маркировке рекламы и дай отчёт с источниками
Выясни, что нового в последнем релизе Postgres, со ссылками
Исследуй конкурентов сервиса бронирования, нужен отчёт с цитатами
Поищи свежие исследования про интервальное голодание и кратко изложи с ссылками
en: Search the web for how Stripe and Paddle pricing differs, with sources
Do a market overview of CRMs for small business with links
Look up the current ad-labeling requirements and give a cited report
Find out what's new in the latest Postgres release, with links
Research competitors of the booking service, I need a report with citations
Look for recent studies on intermittent fasting and summarize them with links

quality_mode.effect: = depth: quick 1 подвопрос и 5 источников; standard 3-4 и 10; full(deep) 6 и 20 + проход по контрпримерам

nodes.prompt: Split the question into 1-6 sub-questions (by depth), define the time window, acceptable source types (primary, official, peer-reviewed, reputable press) and what would count as an answer. If the question is too vague to search, return needs_clarification with one question.

child.prompt: Tavily search then extract for the sub-question {{item}}: candidates with URL, title, date, snippet; extract full text of the best 2-4. Mark each source as full_text, snippet, metadata_only or unavailable. A search result is a candidate, not a fact.

nodes.prompt: Build the list of claims that answer the question. A claim stands with two independent sources (different organizations, not copies of each other), otherwise it is `unverified` and says so. Seek counterevidence and alternative explanations before the main conclusion. Keep observation, inference and opinion apart; numbers belong to their source and sample.

Short answer first, then findings with numbered citations [n] after every sentence that states a fact, then limits (what is unverified, unavailable or contested), then the numbered source list (title, publisher, date, URL, access status). No claim without a source number.

nodes.rule: every [n] resolves to a source; every source listed is used; links.verify returns a 2xx/3xx for at least 80% of full_text sources (paywalls and bot blocks are marked, not failed)

input.question: What changed in the React 19 compiler?

expect_outputs: every sentence with a number has [n]

test.live: реальный запрос с ключом из Env Catalog; в отчёте ни одной ссылки, которой нет в списке; ключ не появляется ни в выводе, ни в логах
